sources.title: OWR 25/2021, Witt Nyström contribution
sources.version: Official report PDF, contribution printed pp.1321–1325
sources.scope: Complete contribution; statements/Theorems2,4 and interior construction discussion pp.1323–1324; bibliography p.1325. Full relevant report contribution read, not full workshop proceedings.
sources.evidence: Prior public interior announcement/sketch; smoothness step tentative and permits vanishing density. Not a verified complete earlier proof of the exact strict-data claim.

sources.title: Ross–Witt Nyström, Applications of the duality
sources.scope: Printed pp.1–6 introductory claims; selected obstacle/current/strong-flow contracts pp.7–12; complete Prop3.4 proof pp.15–16; Section4 definitions/duality statements pp.16–18; Theorem6.2 proof p.24; AppendixA pp.26–28. No claim to read every geodesic-ray extension proof on pp.19–23.
sources.evidence: Fully prior strict positive smooth contact-arc construction and PDE/flow bridge. Explicit non-second-differentiability theorem is on |tau|=1. Current interior implication requires added reasoning.

sources.title: Ross–Witt Nyström, author version of Applications
sources.scope: Matched key construction/duality/singularity/Appendix statements against published counterpart; not treated as independent theorem.
sources.evidence: Same source family, not separate novelty evidence.

sources.title: Ross–Witt Nyström, Harmonic discs
sources.scope: Printed315–318 setup/main harmonic-disc obstruction; 322–329 Legendre duality and harmonic-disc statements/proofs relevant to interior route. Not the whole stability-under-perturbations proof.
sources.evidence: Prior duality and failure of harmonic-disc coverage; nonregularity/rank information alone does not locate a second-order Taylor defect.

sources.title: Ross–Witt Nyström, On the maximal rank problem
sources.version: APDE12(2019),493–503 published article (following publisher pages excluded)
sources.scope: Complete mathematical article, especially Theorem2.1/proof pp.495–499 and §3B pp.501–502.
sources.evidence: Strict smooth data with open rank-zero region; interface regularity conjectural there. Does not establish exact interior no-Taylor claim.

sources.title: Ross–Witt Nyström, Dirichlet problem survey
sources.version: arXiv1712.00405v2,24Jan2018; PSPM99(2018),289–330 metadata; published chapter not downloaded
sources.scope: Full relevant §§3.1–3.4 pp.3–5, §4.3 pp.8–9, §§9.1–9.5 pp.32–37 including entire local proofs/sketches and final bibliography. Duality citations checked against primary S04/S02, not every proof in full42pages.
sources.evidence: Boundary self-tangency theorem, rank example, nonsmooth-boundary C1 counterexample distinguished. Explicit interior-location question appears in §4.3 as dated context, not present-day openness evidence.

sources.title: Darvas–Lempert, Weak geodesics
sources.scope: Complete9page author preprint, including Theorem1.1 pp.2–3, all supporting propositions/lemma proofs and contradiction pp.5–8.
sources.evidence: Failure of continuous complex Hessian on closed strip product. Does not identify exact interior defect or smooth disc data.

sources.title: Lempert–Vivas, Geodesics
sources.version: arXiv1105.2188v1,11May2011; current download PDF header v1; journal metadata Duke162(2013),1369–1381
sources.scope: Introduction, exact strip boundary problem/Theorems1.1–1.2 pp.1–3, foliation-variation proof setup pp.3–5. Full proof not independently checked here; stronger closely related Darvas–Lempert proof fully read.
sources.evidence: C3 up-to-boundary obstruction, subsumed for present comparison by S07.

sources.title: Darvas, Morse theory and geodesics
sources.scope: Introduction/Theorems1.1–1.3 pp.1–3 and proof mechanism §§2–3 pp.3–5; not entire final Morse construction proof.
sources.evidence: C3 geodesic obstruction for all compact Kahler manifolds; distinct location/regularity/domain scope.

sources.title: Hu, An obstacle for higher regularity
sources.version: arXiv1808.03498v2,18Mar2019; PDF displayed internal date7Mar2022, retained literally without resolving date discrepancy
sources.scope: Full introductory Problems1.1–1.2/Theorems1.1–1.3/Example1.1/Remark1.1 pp.1–3; opening ODE setup §2 p.4. Not a full independent verification of17page argument.
sources.evidence: Analytic data on flat torus yield arbitrarily high finite regularity without smooth geodesic; not a non-C2 disc example.

sources.title: Hu, Maximum rank in a C-convex ring
sources.scope: Introductory related-research and full main theorem statement pp.1–4, approximation discussion and notation pp.6–7; no full67page proof verification.
sources.evidence: Positive rank theorem in a ring in C^n, not P1-times-disc interior irregularity. Scope exclusion from actual theorem, not abstract.

sources.title: Yao, Asymptotic behavior of HCMA on ALE Kahler manifolds
sources.scope: Full introductory theorem suite/history pp.1–6; entire Theorem9.3 statement/proof and Corollary9.4 statement/proof pp.71–73; full references pp.73–74. Theorem9.3 relies on earlier foliation estimates not reverified here.
sources.evidence: Sufficient small-data local smoothness and asymptotic regularity; no exact predecessor among checked main claims. Does not prove absence elsewhere.

sources.title: Darvas, A decade of metric geometry
sources.scope: §2 pp.2–4 including full small proof and Theorem2.2/Question2.3, §4 Legendre correspondence context, entire references pp.10–12; not every discussion in metric survey.
sources.evidence: Modern survey still cites strip regularity obstructions and APDE rank loss. It is not an exhaustive HCMA priority census.

sources.title: Berman–Lu, From the Kahler-Ricci flow to moving free boundaries and shocks
sources.scope: Introduction relevant HCMA discussion; Remark4.6 and §4.4 pp.551–552, §5 discussion through Remark5.8 p.558, relevant citations. Not whole parabolic convergence proof.
sources.evidence: Credits earlier topology-change/Legendre singularity framework; no exact finite-contact-arc interior theorem in inspected passages.

sources.title: Viklund–Witt Nyström, Competitive Hele-Shaw flow
sources.scope: Classical-vs-competitive model setup p.2, main statements/derivation pp.7–9, interface erosion/further remarks pp.10–12; full-text term scan for Monge/Legendre and table of contents. Not entire stationary proof.
sources.evidence: Different competitive model preserving topology; no HCMA transfer asserted in inspected source. Not used as proof of literature absence.
